function.name: start_gui
function.description: Start the main Lidar Desktop Control Panel (Tkinter GUI).

action.description: Must be exactly one of: 'dump' (show info/stats), 'floorplan' (generate 2D floorplan PNG), 'path' (generate path/trajectory PNG), 'view' (quick matplotlib scatter plot), 'viz' (interactive PRBonn visualizer, auto-converts to mcap), 'viz3d' (tilt-stabilized 3D visualizer), 'viz3d-static' (merged static 3D scan for tripod recordings), 'viz3d-merge' (6-DoF drift-corrected 3D merge for handheld recordings), or 'mcap' (convert to mcap format).

filename.description: The scan base name only (e.g. 'scan_006'). No directory, no extension, no action prefix.

view.status: Launched view for {filename}. Window should appear shortly.

viz.status: Launched viz for {filename}. Window should appear shortly.

viz3d.status: Launched viz3d for {filename}. Window should appear shortly.

viz3d-static.status: Launched viz3d-static for {filename}. Window should appear shortly.

viz3d-merge.status: Launched viz3d-merge for {filename}. Window should appear shortly.

function.name: build_firmware
function.description: Build the ESP32 firmware with arduino-cli via the Makefile.

action.description: Must be exactly one of: 'compile' (compile only, produces build/), 'all' (compile then flash to the connected board over serial), or 'clean' (remove build/ for a from-scratch rebuild).
